winConditions.title: Reduce the Enemy Base to 0 HP
text: Each base starts with 30 HP. Deal enough damage to the enemy base to reduce it to 0 HP and you win the game.
If both bases reach 0 HP at the same time, the game is a draw.

winConditions.title: Empty Deck
text: If you run out of cards in your deck, you keep playing. Each time you would draw a card from an empty deck, you instead deal 3 damage to your base per card.
For example, drawing 2 cards during the regroup phase with an empty deck deals 6 damage to your base.

winConditions.title: Concession
text: You may concede at any time. Simply announce that you concede and you lose immediately.
